expectedText: I usually check the timetable before I travel. Today I am waiting at the main terminal with a small suitcase. My destination is a town by the sea, but there is a delay. I am checking the new departure time and listening to the announcement. My ticket is valid on a direct service, so I do not need a transfer. I am asking the conductor about a seat reservation near the luggage space. My friend is meeting me at the station this afternoon. I am sending her the new arrival time so that she does not have to wait too long. Before I board, I will check the platform display once more.
